title: MV Yanfly Plugin Help: Battle Status Window, hurt icons and death icons?

posts.author: BeeseChorgle
posts.body:
I'm new to RPG Maker MV on terms of plugins, I had bought the Yanfly battle plugin bundle and I was wondering if there was a way to make it so that when an actor gets hurt, the image reacts to that, as in, I drew an image for their battle actor image, a hurt actor image, and also a death actor image for when they're fallen in battle. Now, I know NOTHING about coding, so I was wondering if anyone out there in the community could help me out? Please?
(something easy too, like a strip of code I could use and tips since I know nothing (sorry if this is the wrong place to post this, it's my first time))

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
With hurt do you mean when they take a hit or when they're low hp?
If it's low hp or death I think you can get the waynee custom face eval
